mapper.select: select distinct tr.id, tr.name, tr.type, tr.icc_priv_json, tr.capp_priv_json, tr.admin_priv_json, tr.im_org_priv_json, tr.status, tr.gmt_created, tr.gmt_modified from tb_role tr, tr_user_role tur, tb_im_user tiu where tiu.id = tur.user_id and tur.role_id = tr.id and tiu.id_card = #{idCard}

select distinct tr.id, tr.name, tr.type, tr.icc_priv_json, tr.capp_priv_json, tr.admin_priv_json, tr.im_org_priv_json, tr.status, tr.gmt_created, tr.gmt_modified from tb_role tr, tr_user_role tur, tb_im_user tiu where tiu.id = tur.user_id and tur.role_id = tr.id and tiu.id = #{userId}
